hooks.text: 混合文化、职业与宗教，组合出1000多种开局英雄
hooks.excerpt: Merge culture, class and religion to establish a starting hero, unlock more options as you play, with 1000+ potential combinations
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 从50多种元素能力与带特殊效果的武器护甲中自由配装
hooks.excerpt: Customize your hero with 50+ elementally-aligned powers such as Pyrokinesis, Necromancy, Blood Retort, Obedient Ice... Discover and freely equip unique weapons and armor with impactful abilities
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 叠加触发效果制造破格构筑，让藤蔓穿刺联动闪电或传送心灵光束
hooks.excerpt: Explosive synergies await... A "broken build sandbox" - create devastating combos by combining triggered effects. Shoot bolts of lightning when you pierce enemies with vines, teleport while emitting psychic beams, etc...
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

opinions.text: 复古审美和怀旧感仍然讨喜。

excerpts.excerpt: I still like the aesthetic and retro nostalgia
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段

opinions.text: 游戏几乎会自行运行，令人无聊。

excerpts.excerpt: There's not a lot to actually do in game, it plays itself
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段

excerpts.excerpt: The lack of input from the player become readily apparent
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段

opinions.text: 开局一次性倾倒过量信息。

excerpts.excerpt: the game throw a metric ♥♥♥♥ ton of information about stats, character classes/races, items
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段

opinions.text: 构筑判断所需信息量过大。

excerpts.excerpt: there's just too much information to dive into to determine whether a build is successful or not
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段

opinions.text: 战斗体验浅薄，大多数时间只需按TAB。

excerpts.excerpt: the actual gameplay experience is shallow and doesn't offer much since you're just going to be pressing TAB most of the time
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段

excerpts.excerpt: most runs end up feeling pretty samey
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段

excerpts.excerpt: playing it doesn't inspire much joy
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段

baseline.message: 首期基线，暂无可比趋势。
